baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun عَصْر and the oath construction وَٱلْعَصْرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The named span is not inert chronology: recurrence, alternation, and the arrival of phases let temporal succession function as a witness that repeatedly exposes what occupies it.

activation_trace.role: The literal range of age and recurring time supplies the successive temporal field and gives that field an evidentiary role in the oath.

changed_reading.before: The phrase is a bare oath by an unspecified unit of time.
changed_reading.after: The oath calls recurring succession itself as witness: alternation and return make temporal passage an active field of disclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ع ص ر in عَصْر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A span can be imagined as a press: sustained enclosure and force draw out a latent liquid, residue, gain, or yield. The oath therefore foregrounds what duration extracts from what it contains.

activation_trace.role: The literal press that makes liquid run supplies the pressure-to-extraction mechanism for the temporal span.
The literal image of bestowed or extracted yield identifies the possible output of the temporal press as gain rather than mere depletion.

changed_reading.before: Time merely passes over its contents.
changed_reading.after: The named span presses what it contains until its hidden yield or lack of yield becomes manifest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical field of ع ص ر carried by the sole focus noun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root can organize a polarity: pressure withholds and reclaims, yet attachment provides refuge and rescue. The oath can name a constraining medium whose grip is dangerous but within which clinging is also possible.

activation_trace.role: The literal refuge, rescue, and attachment image supplies a mode of survival by holding fast within the root's field.
The literal withholding and reclamation image supplies the opposing grip that makes refuge necessary and keeps the model internally tense.

changed_reading.before: Time is only an external threat from which rescue must come elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Al-ʿaṣr can be the constraining grip and, simultaneously, the field in which attachment becomes refuge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form عَصْر as a phase or condition within the root's inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal enclosure need not mean attrition. Reaching youth and grain entering protective sheaths make a span into a maturation chamber in which vulnerability, ripeness, and preservation coexist.

activation_trace.role: The literal arrival at youthful maturity supplies development toward a threshold as one function of the named span.
The literal grain enclosed in its sheaths supplies protective containment as the spatial mechanism of maturation.

changed_reading.before: Aging means only that time consumes what lives in it.
changed_reading.after: The oath can invoke an enclosing phase that brings contents to ripeness while sheltering what is still forming.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ع ص ر in the focus noun, through its meteorological branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The span gathers force like a weather system: cloud is compressed toward rain while wind curls matter into a visible column. Time becomes accumulated pressure approaching release, not a flat line.

activation_trace.role: The literal rain-bearing compression supplies accumulation followed by release as a temporal mechanism.
The literal whirlwind and rising column supply circulation and visible turbulence rather than simple linear passage.

changed_reading.before: The oath points to a fixed time-marker.
changed_reading.after: The oath can evoke a gathering temporal force whose compression, circulation, and eventual release reveal its contents.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human cue activates perception and the pupil-image, revising recurring time into a developing field: the human condition becomes something that comes into view within repeated temporal exposure.

activation_trace.role: Recurring time supplies the repeated interval across which a condition can become visible.
The literal detection of something by sight, sense, or sound makes disclosure, rather than mere duration, the interval's function.
The literal human image in the pupil supplies an optical aperture through which humanity is figured as the image developed in time.

structural_cues: 103:2 immediately places the human after the oath, making the oath's span a plausible revealer rather than background scenery.
The emphatic predication in 103:2 sharpens the move from an open temporal field to a disclosed human condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring time, sensory detection, and a human image in the pupil; I supply the arrow that recurrence develops or exposes the human condition like an image. A live alternative is that the human is simply the proposition's subject and the optical resonance does no causal work.

changed_reading.before: Recurring time witnesses events from outside them.
changed_reading.after: Recurring time is also the exposure medium in which the human condition becomes perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commercial loss and deficient measure turn the temporal press into an assay. The span extracts an output, then exposes it as a negative return or an underfilled measure; loss is thus diagnosed rather than merely announced.

activation_trace.role: The literal press supplies the force that extracts and tests what the span contains.
The literal extracted yield supplies the expected output against which deficiency can be registered.
The literal commercial loss turns extracted output into a negative return and gives the mechanism an accounting frame.
The literal short measure makes loss a measurable failure to deliver the full yield.

structural_cues: The construction لَفِى خُسْرٍ places the human inside loss, matching material held inside a press or assay.
The oath precedes the loss statement, allowing the focus noun to provide the diagnostic process for the verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, extracted yield, trade loss, and deficient measure; I supply the arrow that a lifetime is the assay that exposes short output. A live alternative is a looser commercial metaphor in which time only supplies the period over which loss accrues.

changed_reading.before: The span presses its contents and may produce a neutral yield.
changed_reading.after: The span is an accounting press whose extracted return reveals the human measure to be short.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exception's security and settled trust select the refuge pole already latent in ع ص ر. The temporal field remains constraining, but trust makes holding fast within it a real counter-mechanism to loss.

activation_trace.role: The literal refuge and clinging image supplies the focus-side possibility of rescue through attachment.
The literal settling of the heart in safety and trust supplies the stable interior condition that makes refuge operative.
The literal assent that brings reassurance makes clinging an entrusted commitment rather than frightened grasping.

structural_cues: إِلَّا opens a reversal after the universal loss statement, inviting an already latent focus branch to become the exception's mechanism.
Faith begins the exception sequence before action and mutual counsel, so interior security can function as its stabilizing entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge within ع ص ر and heart-settling trust within faith; I supply the arrow that the exception activates that refuge pole. A live alternative is that faith rescues from time without making refuge a live resonance of the focus noun.

changed_reading.before: The root's refuge image is an isolated lexical possibility beside temporal pressure.
changed_reading.after: The exception activates a trusted mode of clinging, so the same temporal medium that constrains can also hold a refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intentional work and suitability against corruption convert extraction and maturation into cultivation. A span does not automatically yield gain: action works the material, while fitness and repair keep the developing output from spoiling.

activation_trace.role: The literal yield and extracted gain supplies the productive output toward which the temporal process can tend.
The literal grain protected in its sheath supplies a developing product whose preservation matters before harvest.
The literal intended act supplies deliberate labor rather than passive occupation of time.
The literal wage or worker's provision supplies a return correlated with labor and sharpens the yield model.
The literal opposition to corruption supplies preservation from spoilage within the productive process.
The literal fitness of a thing supplies the matching of action to material and purpose required for a sound yield.

structural_cues: Faith is followed by a coordinated verb of doing and a plural object of sound deeds, making productive process more specific than an abstract state.
The exception sequence moves from interior trust to enacted and fitted output.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extracted gain, protected grain, intentional labor, return for labor, anti-corruption, and fitness; I supply the cultivation arrow linking them into one temporal production cycle. A live alternative is that these remain independent moral and economic images without an agrarian process.

changed_reading.before: Time extracts whatever yield happens to be present.
changed_reading.after: Al-ʿaṣr is a cultivation interval whose yield depends on deliberate work fitted to its material and protected from corruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: Connection and exchanged counsel turn refuge from solitary clinging into a relay. Persons join one temporal segment to another, transmitting what one span would otherwise withhold or erase.

activation_trace.role: Recurring time supplies the succession of intervals across which a relay must pass.
The literal attachment and refuge image supplies holding-fast as a social rather than merely individual survival mechanism.
The literal joining of one thing to another supplies continuity between persons and temporal segments.
The literal mutual exchange of counsel supplies reciprocal transmission instead of one-way instruction.

structural_cues: The same reciprocal verb occurs twice, at words 6 and 8, creating two social links rather than one isolated exhortation.
The repeated construction connects distinct objects and gives the end of 103:3 a relay-like rhythm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal succession, attachment, joining, and reciprocal counsel; I supply the arrow that mutual counsel bridges otherwise separate spans and persons. A live alternative is that the repetition intensifies two duties without implying temporal transmission.

changed_reading.before: Refuge within time is an individual's act of clinging.
changed_reading.after: Refuge becomes a reciprocal relay that carries sustaining content across persons and successive spans.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withholding or reclamation, deficient measure, and a fixed due combine into a legal-economic reading. The span matures claims and settles accounts: it exposes what was underdelivered and what belongs or is owed.

activation_trace.role: The literal withholding and reclamation of property supplies collection and recovery as the focus-side operation.
The literal reduction of measure supplies the actionable shortfall that settlement exposes.
The literal binding due supplies obligation and entitlement as the norm against which shortfall is judged.
The literal right held by an owner supplies a claimant, preventing truth from collapsing into abstract correctness.
The literal reality that must be preserved supplies enduring content that remains due across the settlement interval.

structural_cues: Loss is stated before the exception, while الحق appears inside the reciprocal practices that reverse it.
The oath can therefore frame the movement from registered deficit to the preservation and discharge of what is due.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reclamation, short measure, binding obligation, owned right, and preservable reality; I supply the arrow that time acts as a settlement interval that matures and collects claims. A live alternative is moral accounting without any quasi-legal agency assigned to the span.

changed_reading.before: Time reveals a general or commercial deficit.
changed_reading.after: The span settles a due account, exposing underdelivery and reclaiming what truth identifies as owed or worth preserving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The press is revised into a pressure vessel. Self-restraint and closure keep force from becoming rupture, while reciprocal counsel distributes the work of containment; endurance preserves the contents long enough for pressure to yield rather than destroy.

activation_trace.role: The literal press supplies sustained force and the possibility that containment can produce an extract.
The literal reciprocal exchange of counsel makes containment a shared maintenance practice rather than solitary resistance.
The literal restraint of the self from panic supplies internal containment under pressure.
The literal stopper for a vessel or well supplies the material closure that prevents contents from escaping under strain.

structural_cues: The final occurrence of the repeated reciprocal verb leads directly to patience, making endurance the sequence's closing operation.
The surah ends on صبر, so containment has a terminal, sealing position.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressing force, reciprocal counsel, self-restraint, and a physical stopper; I supply the pressure-vessel arrow in which shared patience prevents rupture and preserves yield. A live alternative is that the stopper is only a distant material analogy and patience simply names moral endurance.

changed_reading.before: Temporal pressure extracts and exposes, with no mechanism preventing collapse.
changed_reading.after: Reciprocal patience turns al-ʿaṣr into a maintainable pressure vessel whose contained force can yield rather than destroy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a temporal oath is being activated through weather branches and a form-distant cloud image. It remains anchored in the focus root's explicit rain-compression branch and is independently sharpened by the context's piled-cloud branch; downstream prose should present it as a material resonance of delayed release, not as a replacement gloss for عَصْر.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rain-bearing branch of ع ص ر attached to the sole focus noun.

activation_trace.role: The literal compression of rain-bearing cloud supplies a reservoir that gathers until release.
The literal piled white cloud supplies patient accumulation and makes delayed release visible as a context activation.

changed_reading.before: Time is dry chronology that only drains what it contains.
changed_reading.after: Al-ʿaṣr can resonate as a compressed cloud-reservoir: patient accumulation precedes a release that may become rain rather than loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it promotes a rare choking-and-sipping branch into a model of the surah's ending. It remains anchored directly in the focus inventory and gains a visible sequence from reciprocal counsel, reality, and restraint; downstream prose should qualify it as a bodily analogy for traversing pressure, not claim that the focus noun lexically denotes counsel in small doses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ع ص ر branch of sipping little by little to pass a choking morsel.

activation_trace.role: The literal small repeated sips that ease a choking passage supply the bodily mechanism for surviving constriction incrementally.
The literal reciprocal exchange supplies repeated interpersonal delivery rather than a single rescue event.
The literal stability that matches reality supplies the sustaining content conveyed through the repeated exchange.
The literal restraint from panic supplies the paced response needed for the incremental passage to work.

changed_reading.before: The pressure of the span is endured as one overwhelming block.
changed_reading.after: The constricting span can be traversed by small, repeated, reciprocal doses of reality and restraint that let what chokes gradually pass.

strongest_changes: The loss cue converts the focus root's press and yield into an assay or ledger that exposes underfilled human output.
The exception activates the root's refuge pole, then makes temporal yield depend on trusted, deliberate, fitting work.
Repeated reciprocal counsel revises individual survival into a relay across persons and turns patience into shared containment under pressure.
Truth's branches add a coexisting settlement reading in which the span matures claims, registers short measure, and preserves what is due.
summary.what_was_special: A one-word oath sustained several live mechanisms without requiring a final choice: recurring witness, press, constraining refuge, maturation chamber, weather system, social relay, settlement interval, and pressure vessel. The context did more than identify 'time'; each ordered cue selected or redirected a different latent branch.
remaining_uncertainties: The ordinary temporal branch is the cleanest lexical reading; it remains uncertain how synchronically the pressure, refuge, maturation, and weather branches should be heard in the bare noun.
The accounting and settlement arrows are strongly cross-supported but may remain metaphoric rather than assign agency to the temporal span.
The cloud-reservoir and incremental-sipping readings are deliberately form-distant and should survive only with explicit exploratory containment.
The models coexist rather than disambiguate whether al-ʿaṣr primarily witnesses, applies pressure, shelters, matures, or releases.
